name: M5.BinaryRecovery.recover_length
statement: ∀ (c : List Bool → ℤ) (p : List Bool) (n : ℕ), (M5.BinaryRecovery.recover c p n).length = p.length + n
guidance: Induct n generalizing p; unfold recover and split the if. List.length_append gives one additional decision each step. This algorithm evaluates the false branch count once and recurses with one fewer undecided position. Return only tactic lines without leading by; preserve exact statement.
